rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for taking part in an activity, process, or matter.

example.english: Residents' involvement was crucial to the whole project.
example.traditional: 居民嘅參與對成個計劃好重要。
example.jyutping: geoi1 man4 ge3 caam1 jyu6 deoi3 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this casual construction when stressing that someone takes part in doing something.

example.english: Your involvement in helping with the event means you can't back out at the last minute.
example.traditional: 今次搞活動你都有份幫手，唔好臨時縮沙呀。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 gaau2 wut6 dung6 nei5 dou1 jau5 fan2 bong1 sau2 m4 hou2 lam4 si4 suk1 saa1 aa1

rows.note: Use this when involvement implies active commitment or personal investment, not just participation.

example.english: Their deep involvement in the job means they still think about how to improve it after work.
example.traditional: 佢對呢份工作好投入，放工都仲諗住點樣做好啲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ne1 fan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 tau4 jap6 fong3 gung1 dou1 zung6 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 zou6 hou2 di1
